SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
Translation of Despatch from the Public Safety Bureau (Shanghai).
No. 32. April 28, 1931.
CONFIDENTIAL
Commissioner Martin,
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sir,
It is stated in the instructions from the Head-
quarters of the Woosung and Shanghai Garrison Commander
that precautionary steps be taken to prevent the commu-
nists from carrying out their plans for strikes etc, on
the various commemoration days in the month of May,
namely 1st, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th and 30th. The slo-
gans to be used will be "Opposing the People's Conven-
tion", Upholding the Soviets' Movement" and "Good
treatment to Labourers".
In compliance with the above, I, apart from cir-
culating necessary instructions among various stations
of this bureau, have to request that you will also
taken such steps, as may be necessary, to maintain
order on the above mentioned dates.
Chen Liyi Tseng
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.
A. C. / Special Branch ()
Reg. Acknowledge letter with thanks
and state matter is receiving attention

先生：
据吴淞及上海警备司令部总部指令称，须采取预防措施，以防止共产党在五月各纪念日（即1日、3日、4日、5日、7日、9日和30日）实施罢工等计划。拟使用的口号为“反对国民会议”、“拥护苏维埃运动”和“优待劳工”。
遵照上述指示，除在本局各分局传达必要指令外，特请贵方亦采取必要措施，以在上述日期维持秩序。
陈立义曾
上海市公安局局长

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Despatch from the Public Safety Bureau (Shanghai)

No. 30.                                          April    27,        1931.

CONFIDENTIAL.

Commissioner Martin,
    Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sir,
    I have to inform you of the receipt of instructions
from the Headquarters of the 'Crown' and Shanghai Garrison
Commander to the following effect:
    "It is stated in the report from our Detective Corps
that, according to confidential information, the
Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Communists have
planned, after receipt of circulars from the Communist
headquarters, a joint meeting of all labourers and
students in Shanghai with a view to making a threatening
demonstration either before or after the Anniversary
of May 1st. It is, therefore, instructed that
precautionary steps be taken to prevent the accom-
plishment of the communists' plans for the month of May."
    In connection with the above, I have no hesitation
in saying that the great number of communistic commemoration
days in the month of May gives opportunities to the
communists in stirring up trouble. Consequently, I have to
request that such measures be taken in order to check the
movements of the communists.

                                        Chen Iyi Tseng
                                Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.

（批：Reg
Please reply acknowledge
saying matter is receiving
attention.  H.B. 27.4.31.
Dist. (Special Branch).
E.J.S.）

上海市公安局公函译文

第30号。                                          1931年4月    27日。

机密。

马丁总监，
    上海公共租界工部局警务处。
先生：
    兹告知收到“冠”字及上海警备司令部总部的指令，内容如下：
    “据本局侦探队报告，根据机密情报，共产党江苏省委在收到共产党总部通函后，已计划在上海召集所有劳工和学生举行联合会议，旨在五一纪念日前或后进行威胁性示威。因此，指令采取预防措施，以阻止共产党在五月份计划的得逞。”
    鉴于上述情况，本人毫不迟疑地指出，五月份众多的共产主义纪念日为共产党煽动骚乱提供了机会。因此，特请采取相应措施，以遏制共产党的活动。

                                        陈立义曾
                                上海市公安局局长

（批注：登记
请回复确认
并称此事正受关注。 H.B. 1931.4.27.
分发（特务处）。
E.J.S.）
